name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-12-04, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.31 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
